caption: Two gym memberships since March and I only just caught it. What's quietly leaving your account right now?

slides.title:
How I spend
my R19 500
p/m salary
Living in Upington
slides.body:
Female, 27
Single, lives alone
Job: Traffic officer, metro police
Net salary: R19 500 p/m

slides.title: Rent
slides.includes: 1 bed, small-town rent is the one thing that doesn't stress me here
slides.body: This is the cheapest part of living out here. Everything else makes up for it.

slides.title: Car instalment
slides.includes: Have to have my own car for shift changeovers
slides.body: The job doesn't run on taxi hours. Neither does my car payment.

slides.title: Groceries
slides.includes: Shoprite, plus the Spar top-ups when I'm working late
slides.body: Small town, big grocery bill. Nobody warns you about that trade.

slides.title: Forgotten subscriptions & debit orders
slides.includes: A gym I haven't been to since March, a doubled data bundle, an insurance add-on I never cancelled
slides.body: Found out about the second gym membership by accident. Cancelled it the same day, still annoyed about it.

slides.title: Funeral policy
slides.includes: My own, plus a small top-up for my gran
slides.body: Cheapest line on this list and the one I'd never cut.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Medical aid, electricity, phone & data, savings, a stokvel with the girls I trained with
slides.body: Once the leaks came out, this line finally looked like what it should.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R19 500. More than I expected once the leaks were gone.

slides.title: I stopped paying for things I'd forgotten about
slides.body:
Beyond Horizon flagged the second gym membership as a recurring charge before I'd even noticed it myself.

Cancelling it put R450 back in the account every single month.

No bank login needed.
